span.p:
【衍生】remaining_material_qty: gross_qty - substitute_satisfied_qty
【衍生】physical_gap_qty: MAX(remaining_material_qty - allocated_supply_qty, 0)
【衍生】pending_auth_qty: MAX(gross_qty - authorized_coverage_qty, 0)
【衍生】pending_auth_amount: pending_auth_qty * unit_price

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
【衍生】ending_qty: beginning_qty + arrival_qty + other_inflow_qty - demand_satisfied_qty - other_outflow_qty
【衍生】unmet_demand_qty: required_qty - demand_satisfied_qty

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
【衍生】risk_qty: MAX(ending_remaining_qty - reserved_qty - post_period_consumed_qty, 0)
【衍生】risk_amount: risk_qty * unit_cost
【触发】呆滞风险触发复核: risk_qty ＞ 0

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
【衍生】total_exposure_amount: window_risk_amount + post_window_commitment_amount
【衍生】reducible_qty: MAX(baseline_risk_qty - intervened_risk_qty, 0)

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;
text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p: 【触发】工程变更预防检查触发: approval_status == approved 且 evidence_status == complete

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
【触发】授权数量变化重核算: change_type == auth_qty_change
【触发】替代关系变化复核分配方案: change_type == substitution_change

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p: 【触发】冻结供给排除待核查: supply_type == frozen_stock
